svg.title: How Koala is tested
svg.desc: Root inside the Koala VM attacks guest channels, network, storage and credentials; each is refused at the boundary while a control VM keeps working. Over 40 fuzz targets hit every parser of guest data. About 1,400 crash checks per platform kill processes at chosen moments and the VM starts again. A canary key appears only on the upstream request outside the VM.

g.text: More than 40 fuzz targets: Swift, Go and C
They hit every parser of guest data.
The Swift and C targets run under AddressSanitizer.
About 1,400 crash checks on each platform
Kill the manager, each VM's process and every helper
(image extractor, file transfer, network helper, broker)
at chosen moments. Each case checks that nothing is lost
or left behind, and that the VM starts again.
The canary key appears only on the upstream request.
The same suites run on a Mac and on Linux, and on every release.
